profile.name: Daniyal Ahmed
profile.tagline: I build fast, resilient systems that hold up at scale.
profile.bio: I'm a senior software engineer with nine years of experience designing backend systems, distributed infrastructure, and the occasional interface when a team needs one. My work spans fintech, logistics, and applied AI, usually starting the same way: a system that used to work is starting to buckle, and someone needs it rebuilt without stopping the business in the process. I care about systems that stay legible as they grow, teams that ship without heroics, and code that is still easy to read a year after I wrote it.

experience.summary: Leading the platform team responsible for the payments ledger and settlement pipeline used across the company's core products.
highlights: Redesigned the settlement pipeline, cutting reconciliation time from hours to minutes
Introduced an event-sourced ledger that made audits and disputes traceable end to end
Mentored four engineers into senior roles and rebuilt the on-call rotation around sustainable ownership

experience.summary: Owned the routing and dispatch service that scheduled deliveries across a fleet operating in six cities.
highlights: Rebuilt the dispatch engine on Go and Kafka, tripling throughput during peak season
Cut infrastructure spend by 40% by moving batch jobs off always-on instances
Designed the internal SDK that let five product teams integrate with dispatch safely

experience.summary: Built customer-facing features for a B2B analytics dashboard, from data pipeline to UI.
highlights: Shipped the self-serve reporting builder that became the product's top-used feature
Migrated the frontend from a legacy jQuery codebase to React with zero downtime
Set up the team's first automated testing pipeline, catching regressions before release

projects.title: Ledger Core
projects.subtitle: Event-sourced financial ledger
projects.description: An event-sourced ledger and settlement engine built to make every transaction traceable, reversible, and auditable without locking the whole system for consistency.

projects.title: RouteWise
projects.subtitle: Real-time dispatch and routing engine
projects.description: A routing service that recalculates delivery assignments in real time as traffic, driver availability, and order volume shift throughout the day.

projects.title: DocMind
projects.subtitle: Retrieval-augmented document assistant
projects.description: An internal tool that lets teams ask questions across thousands of internal documents, with citations back to the source paragraph.

projects.title: Pulse Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Self-serve analytics builder
projects.description: A drag-and-drop reporting builder that let non-technical teams construct dashboards from raw product data without writing SQL.

projects.title: Signalbox
projects.subtitle: Alerting and on-call orchestration
projects.description: A lightweight alerting layer built to replace a fragile patchwork of cron jobs and scripts, with clear escalation paths and no alert fatigue.

education.detail: Focused on distributed systems and databases; teaching assistant for the Systems Programming course.
